summary: Iteration 8 — Security audit regression (backend only). 24/24 tests PASS. SEC-001: JWT_SECRET rotation verified — admin@demo.fr / Demo1234! login still works (bcrypt OK), wrong password yields 401. SEC-002 cross-tenant: two freshly-registered admins in distinct companies — Admin B cannot list/GET/PUT/DELETE/transmit/unlock Admin A's project, and /api/integration/sites/{pid} also 404s. Admin A still owns and reads its own project. SEC-002 demo tenants: admin@demo.fr (Escaliers Demo SARL) does NOT see marc@mesureescalier.com (Marc Escaliers Indépendant) project, and reverse access is 404. SEC-002 same-tenant: Sophie (technicien, same company as Marie) sees Marie's freshly-created project in GET /api/projects (unassigned visibility preserved). P3 security headers: X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, X-Frame-Options=DENY, Referrer-Policy=no-referrer all present on /api/. P3 password policy: weak passwords ('shortpw' / 'abcdefgh' / '12345678') correctly rejected with 422, 'Strong1234' accepted. P3 rate-limit: /api/auth/login returns 429 with Retry-After header after >30 failed attempts within window. Regression: full project CRUD, stairs_v2 CRUD, stats, exports (pdf+dxf, <500), photos CRUD, user invite+delete within same tenant — all OK.
action_items: Optional production hardening — replace the in-memory LoginRateLimitMiddleware with Redis-backed slowapi when scaling beyond a single pod (already noted in core/middleware.py docstring).
Optional — consider unifying password policy in a single Pydantic validator class (RegisterRequest and InviteUserRequest currently duplicate _check_password). Minor DRY improvement, not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: core/middleware.py LoginRateLimitMiddleware uses in-memory defaultdict — fine for the single-pod preview but not horizontally scalable; per-IP buckets are also lost on pod restart. Acceptable per the docstring.
core/config.py JWT_SECRET boot guard correctly refuses (<32 chars OR known defaults). Good.
core/security.py project_visible_to() now scopes EVERY query by company_id and returns {'_never_match': True} for users without a company_id — solid fail-closed default.

services/seed.py _backfill_company_ids() is idempotent and groups by company_name first, falling back to a unique per-user tenant. Existing data correctly assigned (3 demo users + 1 existing project visible in logs).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite at /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit.py covers the full security audit (SEC-001 JWT, SEC-002 tenant isolation cross+same-tenant, P3 security headers + password policy + login rate-limit) and core regression (projects CRUD, stairs_v2, stats, exports, photos, user invite/delete). Note: TestZRateLimit MUST run last because it floods the per-IP login bucket — names are alphabetically ordered to enforce this. If you re-run within 5 min of a failed-flood run, subsequent login fixtures may 429; either wait 300s or restart the backend pod to reset the in-memory bucket (`sudo supervisorctl restart backend`).
